idea-plugin.name: JXForge (JXML)
idea-plugin.description:
Editor support for JXML, the markup language of JXForge (part of JXParallel, a Java UI runtime): .jxml screens that are XML and are compiled to Java.

  • JXML file type: .jxml files get their own icon and are XML underneath, so XML editing, folding, formatting and inspections keep working. The "Register New File Type Association" prompt no longer appears.
  • Built-in schema: tag and attribute completion, documentation and validation with no setup, no xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation needed. A file that names its own schema keeps it.
  • Controller awareness: controller="..." resolves to the Java class; #handler and #handler(arg) resolve to its methods (with a "Create method" quick fix); ${a.b.c} and @{x} resolve each segment to the getter along the path, including <For> loop variables; <Include src> resolves to the included file. Completion, navigation, Find Usages and rename work.
  • Highlighting: bindings, two-way bindings and handlers have their own colors (Settings | Editor | Color Scheme | JXML).
  • Gutter icons between a controller class and the screens that use it.
  • File template: New | JXML Screen.

Requires IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2 or newer with the Java plugin.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0 - first release
  • JXML file type with light and dark icons, as a dialect of XML
  • Bundled jxml.xsd generated from JXForge: completion, documentation and validation without configuration
  • References from the screen to its controller: class, handlers, bindings, loop variables, includes; quick fix to create a missing handler
  • Find Usages and rename of controller methods and getters update the .jxml files
  • Color settings page for bindings and handlers; gutter navigation between controller and screen; "JXML Screen" file template
